aiMetadata.description: Creates an end-user account in a Softr app, identified by its domain/subdomain, with an email, name, and password; optionally generates a magic login link. aiMetadata.description: Permanently removes an end-user from a Softr app, identified by the app domain/subdomain and the user email. Use to deprovision a known user. Idempotent in effect on a stable email — once the user is gone the account stays gone — though a repeat call returns a not-found error.
